boundary.method: native Qt paint ownership closed and all owned submissions retired

counters_after.allocation_accounting: renderer-owned resource descriptor bytes; excludes driver padding and opaque depth backing

counters_before.allocation_accounting: renderer-owned resource descriptor bytes; excludes driver padding and opaque depth backing

gpu_telemetry.scope: all recorded compute/render/presentation pass pairs across frame submissions; span encloses pass intervals; excludes uploads before first pass, query resolve/readback, diagnostic quality readback, presentation engine and scanout; pass intervals may overlap

gpu_timing_collection.final_drain: nonblocking event polls after the last completion, outside throughput interval
gpu_timing_collection.instrumentation_cost: resolve/copy work and in-flight query capacity affect actual measured frames; no subtraction
gpu_timing_collection.method: owned asynchronous query maps; frame IDs joined independently of queue completion

run.high_water_scope: process lifetime, including cold setup and warmup; not measured-window deltas
instrumentation_gaps: per-role geometry observation overhead effect on paired timing remains unbounded

issued_frames.scope: successfully begun collector frame requests and their owning phases

begin.scope: process-wide intercepted Vulkan device-memory allocationSize totals; event-level measured window including seeded tracked handles; not physical residency, imported payload size, or opaque driver allocations

end.scope: process-wide intercepted Vulkan device-memory allocationSize totals; event-level measured window including seeded tracked handles; not physical residency, imported payload size, or opaque driver allocations

measured_allocation_window.scope: process-wide intercepted Vulkan device-memory allocationSize totals; event-level measured window including seeded tracked handles; not physical residency, imported payload size, or opaque driver allocations

native_telemetry.binding_decode_scope: nanobind command conversion and owned ByteBlob copies; bytes count payload copies, not Python GLIR packing
native_telemetry.buffer_upload_scope: buffer_upload_cpu_ns includes transient uniform allocation/write/padding and resident geometry allocation/write; buffer_uploads and geometry_upload_bytes count revision geometry only; uniform_upload_bytes separately reports transient uniform payloads; warmed uniform changes can add upload host time without geometry reupload
native_telemetry.cache_lookup_scope: identity/lookup/admission host time excluding portable compilation; pipeline lookup excludes pipeline creation
native_telemetry.capture_scope: copied after the last actual owned Ticket submission and its surface-presentation attempt, if any; cumulative engine observations at that boundary, excluding later callbacks and submissions; unsubmitted terminal frames have no counter snapshot
native_telemetry.completion_scope: Qt paint closure and all owned queued/render/presentation work callback observations, or legacy direct-native present closure; terminal cancellation/loss does not claim GPU completion; excludes scanout; no deliberate wait or present added by telemetry
native_telemetry.compute_scope: compute_passes counts actual encoded compute passes; line_endpoint_dispatches counts actual encoded endpoint DispatchWorkgroups calls; line_endpoint_rows counts valid logical endpoint rows, excluding padded invocations
native_telemetry.cpu_buffer_scope: deduplicated BufferRev CPU vector capacities reachable through live objects, derived caches, pending/queued snapshots and in-flight tickets; excludes keys/container/allocator overhead, texture shadows and driver allocations; sampled peak uses these same ownership checkpoints
native_telemetry.creation_scope: native API invocation counts, including attempts rejected by validation; module/pipeline host calls and existing pipeline validation checks
native_telemetry.descriptor_peak_scope: sampled at explicit probe and marked submission; retained renderer-owned descriptor bytes, excluding driver padding, opaque depth backing, and capture temporaries outside the retained graph
native_telemetry.draw_scope: draw_calls counts encoded user GLIR DRAW snapshots; native_draw_calls additionally includes shader-backed masked/scissored clears, presentation and depth capture draws; clear pass labels retain glClear origin independently of attachment load operations
native_telemetry.gpu_timestamp_clock: device timestamps converted to nanoseconds by Dawn; unrelated to host steady_clock or scanout clock
native_telemetry.gpu_timing_overhead: query resolve/quantization/copy adds GPU work to actual completion and throughput; callback copies mapped values asynchronously; no overhead is subtracted
native_telemetry.gpu_timing_scope: recorded compute/render/presentation pass timestamps across submissions; span encloses all intervals, summed intervals may overlap; excludes uploads before first pass, query resolve/readback, diagnostic quality readback, presentation engine and scanout
native_telemetry.line_resource_pool_scope: sampled resident native pool slots, busy slots and charged resident bytes for owned endpoint output buffers, compute and paired-render uniform buffers, key/slot/control capacities, and the bounded shared diagnostic canary template; the template's actual allocation is included in sampled bytes and its maximum 64 KiB capacity is reserved within the owned-buffer ceiling; temporary transactional staging is bounded separately and excluded from resident pool bytes; borrowed and staged native handles are deduplicated with existing logical resource gauges, which overlap this pool view and cannot be added to it; diagnostic staging readback and retained raw/logical capture bytes are separate ownership; cumulative hits count actual idle-slot owned-capacity reuse, evictions count policy idle victims actually removed, and deferrals count reservations unavailable due to busy ownership, independently of frame-ring deferral; excludes CPU evaluator/consumer allocations and physical driver memory; no hardware qualification claim
native_telemetry.point_conversion_scope: new owned CPU point identity/packed user payloads only; resident reuse and device-loss CPU reuse add no conversions; actual native uploads remain buffer_uploads/geometry_upload_bytes
native_telemetry.shader_stage_scope: actual compiler calls only; retained historical timings are never added on cache hits or portable recovery; SPIR-V includes emission, validation and compatibility passes; reflection includes live resource stage masks and physical uniform layout
native_telemetry.surface_acquisition_scope: unavailable requested attached Qt surface fails that paint owner and GPU record; earlier successful presents remain diagnostic; submitted work retires normally and later repaints may retry; intentional offscreen/no-surface native behavior is unchanged
native_telemetry.terminal_record_scope: separate bounded receipt and GPU-record queues survive canvas teardown; recent empty canvas IDs retain at most 128 tombstones
native_telemetry.timing_scope: inclusive host intervals overlap and cannot be summed; excludes engine mutex acquisition; not CPU thread, GPU, or scanout time
native_telemetry.vertex_input_cache_scope: per-Program historical cache has at most 128 ordinary records and 64 MiB CPU vector/key capacities plus declared record/control/node bookkeeping; eviction uses unordered-map iteration, not recency; allocator headers and bucket padding are excluded; source parents are not retained; oversized records skip historical admission
native_telemetry.vertex_input_conversion_scope: new owned ordinary input/index/topology/selection-bound and batch CPU payloads only; cached capacity decisions do not count as payload conversions; grouped direct views do not copy user payloads; resident/loss CPU reuse adds no conversions; GPU uploads remain buffer_uploads/geometry_upload_bytes
native_telemetry.vertex_input_current_scope: per-Program nine current exact-key owners (six ordinary: index widening, topology, bounds, selection with owned child indices, vertex, instance; plus line endpoint, ordered batch, compact-fit decision) are outside the historical budget, including legal oversized records; all nine share the same historical and oversized working budgets; current_entries/current_bytes and cache_entries/cache_bytes are overlapping sampled owner views across Programs, not additive; current bytes include occupied-slot/key/record/control/child-map bookkeeping with retained record subtrees deduplicated; empty inline slots and allocator headers are excluded; pending/in-flight owners are outside both views; live_cpu_buffer_bytes deduplicates all actual retained vector capacities and live_buffer_bytes all actual retained GPU buffers; current categories replace on successful lookup/build and do not promise arbitrary alternating oversized reuse
native_telemetry.vertex_input_oversized_scope: additional per-Program oversized working history shared by all nine categories (six ordinary plus line endpoint, ordered batch and compact-fit decision): at most 8 entries and 256 MiB occupied entry/key/record/control/child bookkeeping and CPU vector capacities; shared record/child subgraphs counted once; least-recently-used capacity eviction, with current hits refreshing recency; actual DATA/SIZE/DELETE/ATTRIBUTE/LINK or source-stamp invalidation drops dependent categories and permits rebuilding; unchanged source stamps and DRAW selection alternation within admitted budget preserve exact owned children and uploaded resources; over-budget records skip admission but may remain current; evictions counts capacity removals cumulatively, not invalidations; entry/byte gauges aggregate live Programs and overlap current/history/pending owners, so views are not additive; excludes empty container, allocator headers/bucket padding, texture shadows and physical driver memory
native_telemetry.vk_memory_scope: successful intercepted vkAllocateMemory handle allocationSize including slabs/padding; vkFreeMemory handle release may precede payload reclamation; excludes physical residency and opaque driver allocations; retired handles are not frees
native_telemetry.work_peak_scope: renderer pending tickets, queued submission batches, retained draw/clear snapshots and bounded shader cache bytes; not full driver/allocator peaks

observed_gpu_timings.scope: all received warmup/measured maps in arrival order, including rejected batches and failed/partial runs

observed_samples.scope: all received warmup/measured receipts in arrival order, including rejected batches and failed/partial runs

python_telemetry.draw_exclusive: outer draw wall time minus nested outer parser wall time
python_telemetry.draw_inclusive: scene traversal, visual preparation, composition and GLIR generation, including nested parser work
python_telemetry.frame_boundary: begin request through outer Python paint return after swap; swap fallback for backends without Python paint callbacks; completion separately polled
python_telemetry.pack: candidate ndarray contiguity and command payload copying
python_telemetry.paint_tail_parse: outer parser calls after backend swap and before owning Python paint returns; included in total parser work
python_telemetry.parse_inclusive: filtered GLIR interpretation including native/driver calls; candidate includes packing
python_telemetry.scope: benchmark-process wrappers around unchanged scene draw, parser, command packing, update, swap and Python Qt paint callbacks

qt_presentation_setup.scope: Qt default format request before native application/context; not actual presentation evidence

renderer.point_input_limit_scope: all active user point inputs share one vertex buffer; exact vertex/instance identities use read-only vertex storage without reserving a user attribute; actual granted attribute/stride/storage/allocation limits apply
